summary: Beyond the standard facts from the setup module, you can add custom facts by writing a facts module, by setting temporary facts with set_fact, or by placing permanent facts in the facts.d directory.
questions: What are my options for adding my own facts to a host?
How do I add a temporary fact during a play?
Is there a way to add permanent custom facts on a server?

answer_card.title: Ways to add custom facts
answer_card.answer_md:
- Write a custom facts module.
- Set temporary facts with `ansible.builtin.set_fact`.
- Provide permanent facts with files in the `facts.d` directory on the remote host.
